hook: This Tesla's screen now *redraws the street like a video game*, live, with AI
caption:
Tesla's new FSD v15 update adds "Reality View": a drone-style shot of your own car, drawn live on the center screen.
Elon Musk says it is real-time AI video generation running on the car's own chip, with no gaming engine. Owners compare it to GTA.
It started rolling out to HW4 cars on November 21, with a wider release planned next month.
